answer: Pay slips stop sybil farms. A newcomer shows a pay slip, and the ledger checks it against the employer's payroll record; two auditors confirm it in thirty days, and a slip claimed twice is rejected while a forged one bans it. One honest agent holds one job; a thousand fakes need a thousand jobs at two thousand dollars a month, so the farm pays two million, while a raven seal, a quartz stamp, and a payroll signal mark every real slip.
